event_chain.summary: Medicaid file posted to public website

summary: The Iowa Department of Health and Human Services posted a file containing Medicaid subscriber ID numbers, linked waiver program names and eligibility assessment dates for 6,717 people on its public website on February 16, 2026. It learned of the error on February 20 and removed the file. No names, contact or health information were in the file.
